original.statement: Telemetry API CEL expressions must be updated to use standard Envoy attributes (filter_state.downstream_peer/upstream_peer, xds.node, fully qualified wasm.* attributes) instead of the custom Wasm extended attributes.

decision.reason: The release note [ev-7e3267b542c5] and the 1.24 upgrade notes [ev-a3db376e8800] both say that CEL expressions in the telemetry API "must use" the standard Envoy attributes. The attributes move from filter_state["wasm.downstream_peer"]/["wasm.upstream_peer"] to filter_state.downstream_peer/upstream_peer, from node to xds.node, and Wasm attributes must be fully qualified. So operators have to rewrite their expressions, which fits a migration subject with migration-required. The kebab-case name "telemetry-cel-peer-metadata-attributes" is built only from the evidence's own key words.
